“Good afternoon Theydies and Gentlethems, we are at an unprecedented moment in history, daring strikes, causes of chaos, and a light at the end of the tunnel for the revolution. This is your broadcast radio host, Finn Midask here with the truth.

To recap some of the big events happening around we have seen the end of the most deadly serial killer of our time. Violet, a disturbed killer forged from poison, has been eliminated.

Other criminals have been stopped, among them a mechanical spider of Central Park was slain as it tried to attack civilians like you. Even more recently, a Fey wolf of Ferrytown has met its end for criminal Vore and drafting Fey deals in bad faith agreements.

All of these unfortunately came with a terrible cost to the people of Hampstead. A swarm feeding on the damnation of its inhabitants orchestrated by one Aljarad Smith has resulted in the devastating explosion that has reduced most of the borough to rubble.

Join the Midask Industries Humanitarian efforts if you’re looking to send resources or volunteer in the reconstruction efforts.

In war correspondence we have seen the schemes of Benedict Arnold, the turncoat of the revolution, be halted by strategically placed explosives crippling and destroying his armada and keeping the Continental Navy from a flanking attack.

Ending today we are looking forward to striking a decisive victory in the upcoming battle with George Washington. Organize at the Samuel Adams, bring your flags, and show your patriotism for our new nation. 

It’s all of you here that have fought tooth and nail and sacrificed all in the name of Liberty that continue to inspire others to rise up. This is where I tip my hat to you all. You not only inspired me to become a voice for you, but have given me a gift that I must repay in kind.

Everyone around, join in hand and please stand with me. *Raise a glass to Freedom*, for it is the taste of a nation where all persons are created equal. It is not without note that what any of us say will be forgotten in time, but that everything we do will echo throughout the eyes of history that watch us. *Take a sip for Freedom*.

We have a great unfinished task in front of us that we may never reach, but shall always strive for perfection, and it is consecrated by the wills of its people, dedicated to its descendants, and honors all who never got to taste it. *Take a sip for Freedom.*

Today we face a dire challenge and set of tasks. Our very way of life for generations to come hang just within our reach. Some may say it is a pile of bodies that let us get close, but they are mistaken. It is a mountain of our hopes and dreams where we chose to forge our own destiny. *For that, I take a sip in the name of Freedom.*

We will leave our loved ones carrying their aspirations for tomorrow. We honor them by fighting for this in the name of glory. Today I ask you to trust me, let us be joined in purpose and vision. This day we stand united in the face of Tyranny. We stand as one. 

Join me, let us not just taste it, let us take it. ***Take a stand for Freedom!***

This has been Finn Midask with the truth, Signing off”
